title: A Killer Paradox
overview: When one accidental killing leads to another, an ordinary young man finds himself stuck in an endless cat-and-mouse chase with a shrewd detective.

title: A Love So Beautiful
overview: Love is as tough as it is sweet for a lovestruck teenager, whose relationship with her next-door neighbor transforms as they grow into adulthood.

title: A Time Called You
overview: A grieving woman magically travels through time to 1998, where she meets a man with an uncanny resemblance to her late love.

title: Behind Your Touch
overview: A psychic vet and a detective join forces to crack small-town cases — but their skills are tested when they unravel a chilling serial killer mystery

title: Captivating the King
overview: Amid a royal and political power struggle, a king entangles with an intriguing woman — whose hidden desire for revenge transforms into unintended love.

title: Cashero
overview: An ordinary man who inherits super strength discovers a greater evil out to steal his power. The one catch? Every use drains money from his wallet.

title: Celebrity
overview: Fame. Money. Power. One young woman fights to become the next hottest celebrity in the glamorous yet scandalous world of influencers in Seoul.

title: Crash Course in Romance
overview: The series follows the bittersweet relationship between a banchan shop owner whose daughter enters the war of Korea's college entrance exams, and a top hagwon instructor.

title: D.P.
overview: A young private's assignment to capture army deserters reveals the painful reality endured by each enlistee during his compulsory call of duty.

title: Daily Dose of Sunshine
overview: A kind-hearted nurse working in psychiatry goes above and beyond to be a ray of light for those under her care, despite the challenges coming her way.

title: Dear Hongrang
overview: When a long-missing heir returns with lost memories, love and suspicion entwine. Is he truly Hongrang, or a stranger disturbing hearts and family ties?

title: Doctor Cha
overview: Twenty years after leaving her medical career, a housewife returns as a first-year resident — struggling to find her footing in a job full of surprises.

title: Doona!
overview: A college student navigates life and school while dealing with a unique predicament — he's living with a beautiful former K-pop sensation.

title: Karma
overview: A fateful accident intertwines six lives in a thrilling tale of karma and crime, where each must face their own dark truths and connections.

title: Kingdom: Ashin of the North
overview: Tragedy, betrayal and a mysterious discovery fuel a woman's vengeance for the loss of her tribe and family.

title: Little Women
overview: Three sisters, who only have each other and never enough money, get entangled in a conspiracy involving the rich and powerful.

title: Love to Hate You
overview: For an attorney who despises losing to men and an A-list actor who distrusts women, love means nothing — until they're forced to date each other.

title: Mad for Each Other
overview: Bothered to realize they are next-door neighbors and share a psychiatrist, a man and a woman find it's impossible to stay out of each other's way.

title: Mask Girl
overview: An office worker who is insecure about her looks becomes a masked internet personality by night — until a chain of ill-fated events overtakes her life.

title: Move to Heaven
overview: Finding life in all that’s left behind, a detail-oriented trauma cleaner and his estranged uncle deliver untold stories of the departed to loved ones.

title: My Country: The New Age
overview: Set during the turbulent time of the fall of Goryeo and the founding of Joseon, two former friends face-off against one another over a woman and the future shape of the nation.

title: My First First Love
overview: Due to various personal reasons, a group of Yun Tae-o’s friends move into his house, where they experience love, friendship, and everything in between.

title: My Holo Love
overview: Unexpected love finds a lonely woman when she forms a connection with a humanlike hologram who looks exactly like his prickly creator.

title: No Tail to Tell
overview: Imbued with the power to grant wishes, a cynical nine-tailed fox's life takes a turn when she encounters a soccer player — altering both of their fates.

title: Notes from the Last Row
overview: A literature professor discovers a student's talent and offers him writing lessons — but as he sinks into the story, their sessions spiral into chaos.

title: Our Blues
overview: Romance is sweet and bitter — and life riddled with ups and downs — in multiple stories about people who live and work on bustling Jeju island.

title: Our Unwritten Seoul
overview: Twin sisters, whose similarities end with their looks, swap identities amid personal struggles — embarking on a journey to rediscover love and life.

title: Pro Bono
overview: When a respected judge's world falls apart overnight, he joins a top law firm's pro bono team — where hope and purpose wait in humble, unexpected places.

title: Romance Is a Bonus Book
overview: A gifted writer who's the youngest editor-in-chief ever at his publishing company gets enmeshed in the life of a former copywriter desperate for a job.

title: Rookie Historian Goo Hae-Ryung
overview: The story takes place at the beginning of the 19th century. Goo Hae-Ryung is a historian who tries to fight gender stereotypes as her work is often looked down on. She meets Prince Yi Rim.

title: Run On
overview: Veering off course from his preset path, a track star follows his own pace and heart for the first time after a film translator steps into his life.

title: Sisyphus
overview: An unfathomable incident introduces a genius engineer to dangerous secrets of the world — and to a woman from the future who's come looking for him.

title: Still Shining
overview: A man and a woman whose lives are shaped by loss and time drift apart in youth and reunite a decade later, discovering that the bond they once shared remains a guiding light through love, grief, and growing up.

title: The Good Bad Mother
overview: A tragic accident leaves an ambitious prosecutor with the mind of a child – forcing him and his mother to embark on a journey to heal their relationship.

title: The Trunk
overview: A secret marriage service is uncovered when a trunk washes up on the shore, revealing the strange marriage between a couple in the thick of it all.

title: Thirty-Nine
overview: Leaning on each other through thick and thin, a trio of best friends stand together as they experience life, love and loss on the brink of turning 40.

title: Typhoon Family
overview: Depicts the struggles of small and medium-sized businesses and their families who face the 1997 IMF crisis head-on.

title: Under the Queen's Umbrella
overview: A spirited queen tries to rein in her rowdy sons in order to make one of them the next king of Joseon, while her competitors vie to snatch the throne.

title: Undercover Miss Hong
overview: A retro office comedy depicting the chaotic events that unfold in the late 1990s when Sammo Hung, a 30-year-old elite securities supervisor who only cares about work, goes undercover as a 20-year-old high school graduate employee at a securities firm where suspicious money flows are detected.

title: Vagabond
overview: Stuntman Cha Dal-geon gets involved in a tragic airplane crash and ends up discovering a national corruption scandal in the process. Go Hae-ri, the oldest daughter of a deceased marine, decides to work for the National Intelligence Service as a secret ops agent in order to support her mom and younger siblings, although all she wanted to do is to become a civil servant.

title: You and Everything Else
overview: From teen years to adulthood, two friends linked by warmth and tension grow apart — until one is asked to accompany the other through her final days.
